LITERATURE MAP

阅读地图

从经典理论到现代自修改系统，围绕价值、认识与学习机制，理解反馈为何支持进步，也可能维持错误。

01

价值与评价

凭什么判断修改更好？区分最终目标、训练奖励与自修改的决策。

  • 内部奖励为什么可以不同于最终目标↗

    Singh et al. (2010). Intrinsically Motivated Reinforcement Learning: An Evolutionary Perspective. IEEE TAMD.

  • Eureka 如何用反馈改写训练奖励↗

    Ma et al. (2024). Eureka: Human-Level Reward Design via Coding Large Language Models. ICLR; arXiv v2.

  • 改写目标时用哪个目标判断改进↗

    Everitt et al. (2016). Self-Modification of Policy and Utility Function in Rational Agents. AGI; v1.

  • 元决策论怎样判断是否值得继续计算↗

    Hay et al. (2012). Selecting Computations: Theory and Applications. UAI.

  • Gödel machine 怎样接受一次自修改↗

    Schmidhuber (2003/2006). Gödel Machines: Self-Referential Universal Problem Solvers Making Provably Optimal Self-Improvements. v5.

02

认识与交互

怎样获得并理解证据？连接信息、表示、工具与世界模型。

  • Blackwell 信息怎样改善决策↗

    Blackwell (1953). Equivalent Comparisons of Experiments. Ann. Math. Stat. 24:265–272. †

  • 双重控制 行动也在为后续学习获取证据↗

    Klenske & Hennig (2016). Dual Control for Approximate Bayesian Reinforcement Learning. JMLR 17(127).

  • 信息导向采样 探索应服务于找到最优行动↗

    Russo & Van Roy (2014). Learning to Optimize via Information-Directed Sampling. NeurIPS.

  • 可用信息 同一份证据为何对不同学习者作用不同↗

    Xu et al. (2020). A Theory of Usable Information under Computational Constraints. ICLR; v1.

  • 合并阶梯 简单特征怎样成为后续学习的起点↗

    Abbe et al. (2022). The merged-staircase property: a necessary and nearly sufficient condition for SGD learning of sparse functions on two-layer neural networks. COLT.

  • 压缩进展 用刚学会的规律选择下一段经验↗

    Schmidhuber (2009). Driven by Compression Progress: A Simple Principle Explains Essential Aspects of Subjective Beauty, Novelty, Surprise, Interestingness, Attention, Curiosity, Creativity, Art, Science, Music, Jokes. arXiv v2.

  • Epiplexity 有限计算者能够学到多少结构↗

    Finzi et al. (2026). From Entropy to Epiplexity: Rethinking Information for Computationally Bounded Intelligence. 预印本 v2.

  • Toolformer 如何学会调用已有工具↗

    Schick et al. (2023). Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools. NeurIPS; 核对v1.

  • Voyager 如何把技能积累变成后续学习的资源↗

    Wang et al. (2024; 初稿2023). Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models. TMLR; 核对v2.

  • Memento 3 如何用世界模型改进下一轮交互↗

    Zhao et al. (2026). Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks. 预印本 v1.

  • 模型批判为什么不能由后验更新代替↗

    Gelman & Shalizi (2013). Philosophy and the practice of Bayesian statistics. BJMSP 66:8–38; 核对作者v3.

03

学习机制

怎样让下一轮更会学习？比较更新规则、记忆、架构与改进程序。

  • 学习型优化器如何学会更新另一个模型↗

    Andrychowicz et al. (2016). Learning to learn by gradient descent by gradient descent. NeurIPS; v2.

  • 架构搜索怎样学习提出更好的模型↗

    Zoph & Le (2017). Neural Architecture Search with Reinforcement Learning. ICLR; v2.

  • 权重不变时系统怎样继续学习↗

    Wang et al. (2016/2017). Learning to reinforcement learn. arXiv:1611.05763v3.

  • STOP 怎样评价产生改进的程序↗

    Zelikman et al. (2024). Self-Taught Optimizer (STOP): Recursively Self-Improving Code Generation. COLM; v3.

  • DGM 如何让后代程序继续参与自修改↗

    Zhang et al. (2025/2026). Darwin Gödel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents. arXiv v3.

  • HyperAgents 怎样把改进过程也纳入修改↗

    Zhang et al. (2026). Hyperagents. arXiv:2603.19461v1，预印本.

  • 持续学习为什么还需要保持可塑性↗

    Dohare et al. (2024). Loss of plasticity in deep continual learning. Nature 632:768–774; 方法核对作者v3.

04

反馈与学习动力学

为什么反馈闭环既能支持进步，也会维持错误或丢失信息？

  • 反馈怎样纠正学习者↗

    贯通主题

  • 自我确认均衡 为什么正确的反馈仍能留下错误判断↗

    Fudenberg & Levine (1993). Self-Confirming Equilibrium. Econometrica 61:523–545.

  • Berk–Nash 均衡如何解释反馈中的错误自洽↗

    Esponda & Pouzo (2016). Berk–Nash Equilibrium: A Framework for Modeling Agents with Misspecified Models. Econometrica; v4含2019勘误.

  • 内生错设学习 哪些自洽状态能成为长期结果↗

    Fudenberg, Lanzani & Strack (2021). Limit Points of Endogenous Misspecified Learning. Econometrica 89:1065–1098.

  • Performative prediction 预测模型怎样改变下一轮数据↗

    Perdomo et al. (2020). Performative Prediction. ICML.

  • Outside the Echo Chamber 怎样优化部署反馈后的表现↗

    Miller, Perdomo & Zrnic (2021). Outside the Echo Chamber: Optimizing the Performative Risk. ICML.

  • 模型崩溃 为什么只学习上一代输出会逐渐丢失内容↗

    Shumailov et al. (2024). AI models collapse when trained on recursively generated data. Nature 631:755–759; 含2025修订.

  • 数据累积 为什么保留历史会改变自训练的长期误差↗

    Gerstgrasser et al. (2024). Is Model Collapse Inevitable? Breaking the Curse of Recursion by Accumulating Real and Synthetic Data. arXiv v2.

  • 奖励过优化 为什么代理分数提高而参考表现下降↗

    Gao, Schulman & Hilton (2023). Scaling Laws for Reward Model Overoptimization. ICML.

  • 有限判别器 分不清两个分布不等于它们相同↗

    Arora et al. (2017). Generalization and Equilibrium in Generative Adversarial Nets (GANs). ICML.
